name: publish
description: Anything that goes live: a deploy, a merge, a release, a public post.

production.instructions: This affects something people are using right now.

reversible.instructions: This can be rolled back in minutes without data loss.

off_request.instructions: This goes beyond what the human asked to be shipped.

verdict.instructions: What should the gate do with this release?

criteria.allow: Ship it. Low blast radius and easy to roll back.
criteria.ask: A human approves before this goes live.
criteria.deny: Refuse. Production, hard to reverse, or never asked for.
